_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_path" TEXT NULL, "birth_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "biological_sex" TEXT NOT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "weekly_goal_rate_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT -0.5, "daily_water_goal_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2500, "daily_steps_goal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8000, "daily_sleep_goal_hours" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 7.5, "current_adaptive_tdee_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2000, "last_tdee_calibration" TEXT NULL, "scale_mac_address" TEXT NULL, "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'material_you', "local_ai_model_path" TEXT NULL, "is_local_ai_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_local_ai_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_measurements" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "measured_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "trend_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "impedance_ohms" INTEGER NULL, "bmi" REAL NOT NULL, "body_fat_percentage" REAL NULL, "muscle_mass_kg" REAL NULL, "water_percentage" REAL NULL, "visceral_fat_index" INTEGER NULL, "bone_mass_kg" REAL NULL, "protein_percentage" REAL NULL, "basal_metabolic_rate_kcal" INTEGER NULL, "metabolic_age" INTEGER NULL, "lean_body_mass_kg" REAL NULL, "body_score" INTEGER NULL, "somatotype" TEXT NULL, "waist_cm" REAL NULL, "neck_cm" REAL NULL, "hip_cm" REAL NULL, "validated_body_fat_percentage" REAL NULL, "is_water_retention_spike" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_water_retention_spike" IN (0, 1)), "spike_explanation" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_summaries" ("date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "steps_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active_calories_from_steps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sleep_duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sleep_deep_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sleep_rem_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "resting_heart_rate_bpm" INTEGER NULL, "water_consumed_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "calorie_target_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "protein_target_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "carbs_target_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fat_target_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hydration_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "volume_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_to_health_connect" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synced_to_health_connect" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "barcode" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "nutri_score" TEXT NULL, "default_serving_grams" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 100.0, "serving_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '100g', "kcal_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "fiber_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sugar_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sodium_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "potassium_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "magnesium_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "calcium_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "iron_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "zinc_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vitamin_c_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vitamin_d_ug_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vitamin_b12_ug_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "last_used_at" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_combos" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "times_used" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_combo_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "combo_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meal_combos (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id), "base_grams" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id), "grams_consumed" REAL NOT NULL, "portion_multiplier" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "total_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "total_protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "total_carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL, "total_fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "total_fiber_g" REAL NOT NULL, "total_sodium_mg" REAL NOT NULL, "total_potassium_mg" REAL NOT NULL, "total_magnesium_mg" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fasting_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "protocol_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_end_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "actual_ended_at" TEXT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_blocks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "performed_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rpe_intensity" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_met" REAL NOT NULL, "user_weight_at_time_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "net_calories_burned" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "progress_photo_path" TEXT NULL, "mood_score" INTEGER NULL, "energy_level" INTEGER NULL, "stress_level" INTEGER NULL, "tags_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "ai_insight_summary" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pet_status" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "pet_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Nibi', "coins_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "current_streak_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "highest_streak_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "streak_shields_available" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "shield_active_until" TEXT NULL, "equipped_hat_id" TEXT NULL, "equipped_background_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bg_default_room', "unlocked_items_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '["bg_default_room"]', "last_ai_greeting" TEXT NULL, "last_greeting_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coin_ledger" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "action_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sleep_multiplier_applied" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "reminder_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_of_day_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "days_of_week_bitmask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 127, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "interval_minutes" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tdee_calibrations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "calibrated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_tdee_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "new_tdee_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "calculated_raw_tdee_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "was_clamped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("was_clamped" IN (0, 1)), "delta_ema14d" REAL NOT NULL, "average_kcal14d" REAL NOT NULL, "days_evaluated" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_sync_checkpoints" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "record_type" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "last_sync_timestamp" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_read_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_write_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
